|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' ([[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V)]], 7 January 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (8 January 2019). Players Committee card image, 7 January 2019: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-jabbasspacecruiser-20190107.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/jabbasspacecruiser.gif Holotable commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images”], no mark). Text: “May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When deployed, you may ▼ an alien leader aboard for free. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 22 June 2021): Players Committee card image, 22 June 2021: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-jabbasspacecruiser-20210622.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/jabbas_space_cruiser.png Holotable commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images”], mark “E1”). Text: “May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When deployed, may ▼ an alien leader aboard. Immune to attrition < 5.” '''What changed:''' “When deployed, you may ▼ an alien leader aboard for free.” became “When deployed, may ▼ an alien leader aboard.”; re-rendered at 703×980 (was 350×490).
*: [[File:V10-D-jabbasspacecruiser-20210622-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Errata 2)]], 19 August 2024): Players Committee card image, 19 August 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-D-jabbasspacecruiser.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/hires/jabbasspacecruiser.png Holotable commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered”], mark “E1”). Text: “May add 1 alien pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When deployed, may ▼ an alien leader aboard. Immune to attrition < 5.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 10 remaster: the card was re-rendered (745×1039, was 703×980); the words and mark are unchanged. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
